limitations: Measurements use an original synthetic cube reference, not a broad asset quality benchmark.
Text/chat-to-3D chaining, independent editor import, physical scale, rigging and animation remain open.
Mixed image/geometry scheduling is fixture-qualified; sustained multi-user mixed live load remains open.
Shared GPU operation is explicitly selected for this machine; independently resident distributed specialists remain the default.
Console-approved adoption is not automatic enrollment or signed package distribution.
Reusable installer follows the deployed steps but has not had a second fresh-machine qualification.
Head deletion does not erase provider caches or backups.
No full P8, E19, A12 or other release gate is closed.
privacy_note: Private deployment inventory redacted; validation outcomes describe the original run.
